editorial:
Imagine falling asleep in the middle of a sentence or right during a dinner party. That is exactly what happens to Gus, a guy dealing with narcolepsy who just cannot stay awake. You will quickly fall for the funny dynamic between Gus, his supportive wife Pam, and his loyal best friend Lenny. The whole movie feels like a lighthearted ride where the comedy comes from the most awkward moments possible. It is a sweet story about a man trying to find his place in the world while his brain keeps hitting the off switch.

What really makes this work is how the movie shows the colorful comics Gus draws from his dreams. The pacing is snappy, and the acting feels very natural and grounded. While some of the jokes might feel a bit slow at times, the heart of the story keeps you invested. If you are looking for a cozy night in, you should try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or maybe rent it on Apple TV. It is a great choice for a lazy Sunday afternoon with the family.
endingExplained: After struggling with his condition, Gus finally learns to embrace his narcolepsy instead of fighting it. He realizes that his dreams are a gift that allows him to create amazing art. In the final scenes, his comics become a huge hit, turning his struggle into a successful career. He finds a way to balance his health and his passion, ending the movie happy and accepted by everyone around him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky comedies about underdogs.
